_comment: Index, sector, rates, credit, dollar, commodity and volatility ETFs the Market Risk Engine reads from market_quotes (DSN-20261031-market-risk-engine §5.1). They are always quoted, whether or not anyone holds or watches them. Builder H's read-only data audit (PR #2341) found HYG, UUP and VIXY absent from the quote universe on 2026-10-31. Operator approved design §11 item 1 in session 2026-10-31: "I approve and agree to everything one through eight…". Adding a symbol here adds one quote per refresh; nothing else changes.
